stage0072_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$百目鬼$$
「Why?
　This is such a fun event, though.」

stage0072_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$百目鬼$$
「Those things don't mean to destroy the city.
　However you look at it, they're just waiting, I'd say.」

stage0072_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So, you've come, $c.
　And $$金田正太郎$$.」

stage0072_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You punk!
　Don't forget $$竹尾ワッ太$$'s here too!」

stage0072_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　What in the world are you after!?」

stage0072_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Do you not understand unless I say it?
　To settle things with you all.」

stage0072_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$甲児$$
「Moving a force this size...!
　Seems like they're serious!」

stage0072_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「So this is the decisive battle for it all!」

stage0072_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$葵$$
「Let's accept that spoiled prince's declaration of war, shall we?」

stage0072_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Can't just stand and watch this!」

stage0072_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A wielder of the power of life...!」

stage0072_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Assault Love Heart!
　I see, so it means attack all at once!」

stage0072_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's not it, Major $$オズマ$$.」

stage0072_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Lift your head up, $$正太郎$$!
　$$バサラ$$'s trying to encourage you!」

stage0072_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$バサラ$$ isn't the only one
　rooting for $$正太郎$$.」

stage0072_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カレン$$
「We're all with you too, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0072_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you think that Prince $$グーラ$$ is your friend,
　then let's give it everything!」

stage0072_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's right, $$正太郎$$!
　You won't know how it turns out till you try!」

stage0072_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「To reach the heart of an enemy... an alien...
　is that what you're saying...?」

stage0072_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Look at reality, $$クェス$$!
　Doing this is obviously pointless!」

stage0072_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not for you to decide.
　It's $$正太郎$$'s, and that $$グーラ$$'s.」

stage0072_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Is there something you'd like to say, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

stage0072_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If you're going to do it, give it everything!」

stage0072_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here I come, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll be the one to stop you!」

stage0072_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「You're persistent, $$正太郎$$!
　I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...!
　Of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...」

stage0072_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What does that have to do with anything!
　You're my friend!!」

stage0072_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's right!
　Move the mountain, $$正太郎$$!!」

stage0072_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Wait for me, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll definitely move your heart, I swear!!」

stage0072_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop this already, $$グーラ$$!
　Pull your forces back!」

stage0072_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　Are you trying to show me mercy!?」

stage0072_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's not it!
　I don't want to fight you!」

stage0072_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Answer me, $$グーラ$$!
　Do you want to fight me!?」

stage0072_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A foolish question, $$正太郎$$.
　All living things are born to fight.」

stage0072_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$グーラ$$
「The war of god and devil...
　That is the mission imposed on all living things!」

stage0072_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So by devil, he means $$バアル$$...!」

stage0072_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$隼人$$
「God and devil...
　A concept of the fight between good and evil, is it.」

stage0072_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シモン$$
「In other words, humanity's fate is to fight $$バアル$$...!」

stage0072_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's so funny, $$グーラ$$!
　Just because you know a little,
　don't act so high and mighty!」

stage0072_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No wonder the Dark Prince scoffs in derision.」

stage0072_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That Altair guy, $$ミカゲ$$ or whatever!」

stage0072_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アルト$$
「That condescending laugh of yours...!
　I don't like it!」

stage0072_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How rude of me...
　The farce between the Dark Prince and that boy
　was simply too amusing, you see.」

stage0072_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You call $$正太郎$$'s desperate persuasion a farce!?」

stage0072_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I understand plenty.
　I have transcended friendship, hope, love... all of it.」

stage0072_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カナリア$$
「'MY FRIENDS'...
　$$ミレーヌ$$'s own kind of cheer, huh.」

stage0072_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Now I've seen your true colors, $$ミカゲ$$, or whoever you are!」

stage0072_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「A guy who goes out of his way to say
　he can't believe in love or friendship
　secretly longs for it deep down!」

stage0072_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Fire Bomber's song
　is what stirs up feelings like that!」

stage0072_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「To find that unpleasant
　means you must be a real lonely guy!」

stage0072_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$桂$$
「That bastard!
　Not just the Altair army, but the Vajra too,
　he went and called them in!?」

stage0072_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Is this a memory within me...,
　or is it a sealed memory...?）

stage0072_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You wingless wretches, playing such unpleasant sounds...!」

stage0072_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$, are you all right!?」

stage0072_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Our sound
　won't stop for something like that!!」

stage0072_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Been a while, let's do this!」

stage0072_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's do it!
　We'll blow up our souls!!」

stage0072_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Gah...!
　What is that power of his...!」

stage0072_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How unpleasant...!
　I can't stay here any longer!」

stage0072_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The power of $$熱気バサラ$$'s song...?」

stage0072_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Maybe what Major $$オズマ$$ said hit the mark.」

stage0072_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Wait right there!!
　Give $$ＭＩＸ$$ back, I said!!」

stage0072_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
???
「Master $$ミカゲ$$ has returned.
　This is left to us now.」

stage0072_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「To think you drove off the winged one...
　Fearsome, this power of life...」

stage0072_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...A shame, $$正太郎$$.
　Thanks to that interruption, I couldn't
　settle things with you...」

stage0072_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$グーラ$$
「And no matter how you struggle,
　human strength can't defeat them.」

stage0072_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「When the ill star fills the heavens,
　this planet's people will know true despair...
　Farewell, $$正太郎$$.」

stage0072_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$ has returned.
　I'll pull back too.」

stage0072_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$タケル$$
「When the ill star fills the sky...
　What could that possibly mean...」

stage0072_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's for later!
　Let's deal with the remaining enemies and the Altair army!」

stage0072_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　I'll let you all hear plenty of my song!!」

stage0072_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルト$$
「That $$ミカゲ$$ guy
　seems to have lit a fire under $$バサラ$$ instead.」

stage0072_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$'s unstoppable once he's like this!」

stage0072_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Then just sit back and watch, $$ガムリン$$!」

stage0072_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't joke around!
　If you're going to sing, then I'll fight!」

stage0072_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「My fight to protect people
　can't be stopped by anyone!!」

stage0072_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Well look at you, saying that!!」

stage0072_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, continue the engagement!
　Intercept the Altair army and the Vajra!」

stage0072_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Get ready, Altair!
　I'll beat you and get a lead
　on bringing $$ＭＩＸ$$ back!!」

stage0072_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$田中司令$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army, the Altair forces, and the Vajra...
　All have been repelled」

stage0072_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ＷＩＬＬ$$, how do you read the situation?」

stage0072_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「There's little doubt the drop in the Altair forces'
　appearances is due to the dimensional boundary stabilizing」

stage0072_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「But given that, after taking $$ＭＩＸ$$ as a candidate
　for the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$, they've sent troops in again,
　we should assume their goal is still unmet」

stage0072_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In that case, Altair will likely
　launch a large-scale operation before
　the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is complete」

stage0072_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The same likely goes for Prince $$グーラ$$.
　We were interrupted partway through today,
　but I could feel his extraordinary resolve」

stage0072_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And so, the time of the ill-omened star he spoke of...」

stage0072_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$田中司令$$
「As for the movement of the stars,
　nothing unusual has been detected, but...」

stage0072_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We must not forget,
　that a star is a mass of $$次元力$$」

stage0072_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Just as Earth is the ideal place to draw
　out the $$次元力$$ of the 12 zodiac signs,
　some star alignment fit for other ends may be nearing」

stage0072_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We'll need to stay on guard」

stage0072_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$甲児$$
（Don't tell me, Mother's the one moving...）

stage0072_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「It's been a while, $$兜甲児$$.
　And you as well, $c」

stage0072_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So you were alive after all!」

stage0072_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「...but I've grown tired of that, too」

stage0072_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Left the sole survivor of my fallen homeland,
　I struck down my foe Dr. Hell, but lost
　the Mechanical Beast Army as well...」

stage0072_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「All that's left to me now is my
　attachment to you, my old foes」

stage0072_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「I'll decide how the curtain falls on my own life...!
　$$兜甲児$$... I'll have you all lend a hand with that!」

stage0072_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Three days from now, wait at the Science Fortress Institute!
　I'll gather every last bit of my remaining strength
　and challenge you to one final battle!」

stage0072_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「This is my final request, $$兜甲児$$!
　Give my road to death the sendoff it deserves!」

stage0072_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So you've finally made up your mind...」

stage0072_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$あしゅら$$...
　it seems the time has come for you and me
　to settle our long battle once and for all」

stage0072_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Damn it!
　What a disgrace, before Prince $$グーラ$$!」

stage0072_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Fall back, $$ダンカン$$.
　Leave the rest to me」

stage0072_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My apologies, Your Highness.
　Demon General $$ダンカン$$ will withdraw」

stage0072_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Tolerance toward one's subordinates is
　a quality a leader requires」

stage0072_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$グーラ$$
「As is being ruthless toward one's enemies!」

stage0072_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$シモン$$
「So that's how it ends up, huh!」

stage0072_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Enough, $$正太郎$$!
　No matter what you say, the fact
　that you're my enemy will not change!」

stage0072_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$正太郎$$ is betting on the possibility...!
　Never giving up!）

stage0072_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$, what are you...!」

stage0072_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「All we can do for $$正太郎$$ right now
　is cheer him on, isn't it!
　So I'm going to do that with everything I've got!」

stage0072_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Talk to $$グーラ$$ without holding anything back!」

stage0072_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「What...!?
　Power is gathering, centered on $$正太郎$$!」

stage0072_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Your father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　swallows everything with a black hole!」

stage0072_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's right!
　That is my father's power... a power
　far beyond human imagination!」

stage0072_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We're the same way!
　Everyone's hearts come together as one
　and become a great power!」

stage0072_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's the bond between people... friendship!
　So, $$グーラ$$!
　I believe in the power of our friendship too!」

stage0072_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Such a sham of a power...!」

stage0072_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No good, $$正太郎$$!
　Nothing starts until we strip $$グーラ$$
　of his will to fight!」

stage0072_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$タケル$$
「We have to stop his $$スペースロボ$$!
　That's where we start!」

stage0072_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come, $$正太郎$$!
　If you think you can stop me, then try it!」

stage0072_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
???
「Damn it!
　No more fighting is possible, huh!」

stage0072_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I'd wager he's the Altair forces' captain!」

stage0072_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Like hell I'll let you go!
　I'll catch you and get the information
　on $$ＭＩＸ$$ out of you!!」

stage0072_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
???
「Silence!
　As if I'd be caught by some fool from Vega!」

stage0072_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
???
「I'll settle today's debt without fail!
　You'd best remember that!」

stage0072_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Is something wrong with me...?
　Fighting that guy just now felt oddly nostalgic...）

stage0072_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Way to go, $$ガムリン$$!」

stage0072_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「As expected of a Fire Bomber support member」

stage0072_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's an honor to hear you say that」

stage0072_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Bit early to get cocky, $$ガムリン$$」

stage0072_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「You said it, $$バサラ$$!
　Then show me you can raise my spirits even more!」

stage0072_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$バサラ$$
「OK!
　I'll pull you straight into the red zone!!」

stage0072_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
（Say what you want, but those two lately...
　they're totally in sync...）

stage0072_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
（I might get a little jealous, honestly...）

stage0072_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Is there truly no way you'll stop fighting!」

stage0072_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Coward!
　If you're a warrior who protects Earth too, fight me!」

stage0072_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Fine then, I'll defeat your $$スペースロボ$$
　and bring you to your senses, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0072_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$グーラ$$
「If you think you can, then try it!
　But first, I'll destroy your precious $$鉄人$$!」

stage0072_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here I come, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll show you the power of me and $$鉄人$$...
　the power of a warrior who protects Earth!!」

stage0072_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Cut it out already, $$グーラ$$!
　$$正太郎$$ cares about you this much,
　and you just ignore him!」

stage0072_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I'm the one who's bothered by being clung to」

stage0072_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You jerk!
　If you're gonna say that, I've got a plan too!」

stage0072_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll become your friend
　in a way different from $$正太郎$$!!」

stage0072_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, $$グーラ$$!
　We'll slug it out with everything, then
　shake hands tight and be friends!!」

stage0072_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Why won't you see how meaningless and empty fighting is!」

stage0072_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Unbelievable, Mars!
　You, who fought your own brother, lecturing me?」

stage0072_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's exactly why I don't want you or $$正太郎$$
　to taste the sorrow and pain I did!」

stage0072_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$タケル$$
「Understand, $$グーラ$$!
　A fight like this makes no one happy!!」

stage0072_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「You should hear $$バサラ$$'s song too,
　and open your heart!」

stage0072_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「If your heart hasn't fully frozen over,
　the passion still left deep inside it
　will surely revive!」

stage0072_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$グーラ$$
「What reckless logic!
　As if I'd listen to words like that!」

stage0072_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's not logic!
　You feel it with your heart!」

stage0072_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Step aside, $$ガムリン$$!
　If he won't listen to words,
　there's only one thing left to do!!」

stage0072_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, Prince $$グーラ$$!
　Listen to my soooong!!」

stage0072_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$グーラ$$
（My soul is being shaken...!
　Is this the power of life!!）

stage0072_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
???
「I'll take down the Mechanical Angel myself!」

stage0072_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
???
（But, what is this...
　this ache deep in my chest...）

stage0072_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
???
（It's as if someone bored a hole through my chest...）

stage0072_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$グーラ$$
（I... want to touch that animal...）
